1 · Intro

When to use it.

Hiring a staff member is a chain: the position feeds the requisition, the requisition feeds the pending worker, and the conversion builds the assignment and pay. Bad data in, bad data out.

This course is the map. Each step points to the Academy course that covers it in detail.

Use this whenYou need to hire a staff member and want to see every step from requisition to start date.

2 · Walk through

The path to day one.

Check off each item as you read.

Watch-outs

  • Most hire problems start at the position. A wrong location, hours, or job code flows into the posting, the offer, and the first paycheck.
  • Don't convert until PEBC sends clear to start.
  • Open item: confirm with your engagement consultant (EC) any lead times between steps your area should plan for.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

HCM Academy job aid · Hiring

Staff

Use when: You need to hire a staff member and want to see every step from requisition to start date. · System: Process

  1. Get the pre-search memo from Compensation.
  2. Create the position (or update one that fits).
  3. Create the requisition from the approved position.
  4. Work with the recruiter through interviews and the offer.
  5. Wait for background check clearance from PEBC.
  6. Convert the pending worker.
  7. Check costing on day one.

Watch-outs

  • Most hire problems start at the position. A wrong location, hours, or job code flows into the posting, the offer, and the first paycheck.
  • Don't convert until PEBC sends clear to start.
  • Open item: confirm with your engagement consultant (EC) any lead times between steps your area should plan for.
